capabilities: Switch the current note's reading state with one click
Write and remove state tags in YAML while keeping other tags
Move notes into per-state destination folders
List managed notes grouped by state in a sidebar panel
Create a default folder structure for the workflow
disambiguation: Not a reading-plan, schedule or progress-chart tool; it only sets state tags and moves files.
extras: No network requests or data collection; status bar counts are desktop-only; settings live in the vault config and follow Obsidian Sync, while states live in tags and folder positions.
motivation: The author's own clippings piled up faster than they were read, and read-or-not should be a visible state rather than something kept in memory.
problem: Clipped articles and reading notes pile up in one folder with no visible sign of which are unread, half-read or finished.
summary: Sidebar panel and commands that set a note's reading state, syncing YAML tags and moving the file into the state's folder.
